desc_bihun_goreng_ayam: A popular Indonesian stir-fried rice vermicelli dish featuring tender chicken pieces. Thin rice noodles are tossed in a savory mix of sweet soy sauce, garlic, shallots, and vegetables. It is a staple comfort food, often served with pickles and crackers, offering a perfect balance of sweet and savory flavors that is beloved by all ages across the archipelago.
desc_bihun_goreng_seafood: This savory dish elevates classic stir-fried rice vermicelli by incorporating fresh seafood such as shrimp and squid. The noodles soak up the aromatic stir-fry sauce, complemented by the natural sweetness of the seafood and crunchy vegetables. It is a savory, satisfying meal that brings a delightful oceanic flavor to the traditional Indonesian street food experience.
desc_capcay_goreng_ayam: A stir-fried vegetable medley dish inspired by Chinese-Indonesian cuisine, featuring juicy chicken slices. It uses a variety of fresh vegetables like cauliflower, carrots, and bok choy, stir-fried quickly in a thick, savory oyster-based sauce. It is a healthy yet delicious option, perfect when paired with warm white rice for a complete and balanced daily meal.
desc_capcay_goreng_seafood: This variation of the famous vegetable stir-fry includes a bounty of fresh seafood, such as prawns and fish balls. The seafood adds a rich depth to the savory oyster sauce, making the crisp vegetables even more flavorful. It is a protein-packed, vibrant, and nutritious dish that highlights the freshness of ingredients, making it a favorite for family gatherings.
desc_capcay_kuah_ayam: A comforting, soupy version of the vegetable medley with tender chicken. The ingredients are cooked in a light, savory broth thickened with starch, which binds the flavors together. This warm, soothing dish is perfect for rainy days or when you need something light yet nourishing. It is best enjoyed hot, providing a wholesome experience with every spoonful of fresh vegetables.
desc_capcay_kuah_seafood: This seafood-based soup version of capcay combines fresh vegetables and a variety of seafood in a flavorful, thick, light-colored broth. The essence of the seafood infuses the liquid, creating a savory taste that complements the textures of the vegetables. It is a wholesome, hydrating meal that is popular for its refreshing taste and nutritional value in Indonesian households.
desc_kwetiau_goreng_ayam: A delicious stir-fried flat rice noodle dish cooked with succulent chicken. The wide noodles are stir-fried over high heat with sweet soy sauce, bean sprouts, and eggs to achieve a smoky "wok hei" aroma. The contrast between the soft noodles and crunchy vegetables makes it a beloved street food, offering a savory experience that is truly quintessential Indonesian.
desc_kwetiau_goreng_seafood: A savory stir-fry of flat rice noodles loaded with fresh seafood. The noodles are expertly fried with garlic, sweet soy sauce, and high-quality shrimp or squid, creating a mouthwatering meal. It is a popular choice for those who love seafood-centric flavors, providing a chewy, savory, and aromatic culinary delight that is commonly found in Indonesian stir-fry stalls.
desc_kwetiau_siram_ayam: Kwetiau siram features flat rice noodles topped with a rich, thick, savory gravy filled with chicken and vegetables. Unlike fried versions, this dish offers a silky, comforting texture. The gravy is thickened with tapioca starch, creating a glossy and flavorful sauce that coats the noodles perfectly. It is a satisfying, non-greasy meal favored for its smooth consistency.
desc_kwetiau_siram_seafood: This dish consists of flat rice noodles drenched in a savory, thick gravy infused with the taste of fresh seafood. The combination of succulent shrimp, squid, and mixed vegetables makes the sauce complex and appetizing. The contrast between the soft noodles and the rich, glossy gravy creates a delightful eating experience, highlighting the freshness of the sea in every bite.
desc_mie_goreng_ayam: The quintessential Indonesian noodle dish, made with yellow wheat noodles stir-fried with chicken, sweet soy sauce, and vegetables. Often featuring eggs, meatballs, and pickled chili on the side, it is a staple throughout the country. Whether bought from a street cart or made at home, its familiar sweet-savory profile is the ultimate comfort food for many Indonesians.
desc_mie_goreng_seafood: A flavorful twist on the classic fried noodles by adding fresh seafood like shrimp and squid. The stir-frying process allows the noodles to absorb the savory sauce, while the seafood provides a natural sweetness and firm texture. This dish is popular in coastal regions and restaurants, offering a slightly more sophisticated and oceanic take on a well-loved Indonesian classic.
desc_mie_rebus_ayam: A hearty noodle soup featuring yellow wheat noodles cooked in a spiced, thickened broth with chicken. The soup is typically enriched with garlic, shallots, and various spices, giving it a comforting, warm aroma. It is a popular evening dish in Indonesia, especially during cooler weather, offering a filling and soothing meal that warms the soul with every flavorful spoonful.
desc_mie_rebus_seafood: This noodle soup variation uses a fragrant, thickened broth packed with fresh seafood. The broth gains extra umami from the seafood, making it deeply satisfying and flavorful. With the addition of fresh vegetables and sometimes egg, it becomes a complete meal. It is a prized dish for those looking for a warm, comforting bowl that highlights high-quality ingredients.
desc_nasi_goreng_ayam: Indonesia's iconic fried rice made with pre-cooked rice stir-fried with sweet soy sauce, chicken, garlic, and shallots. It is usually served with a fried egg, shrimp crackers, and fresh slices of cucumber. Simple yet incredibly flavorful, this dish is a culinary symbol of Indonesia, enjoyed at any time of day, from humble street-side stalls to upscale restaurant menus.
desc_nasi_goreng_gila: A popular, chaotic, and hearty version of fried rice where the rice is topped with an abundant mix of sausages, meatballs, chicken, and vegetables cooked in a spicy, savory sauce. The term "gila" (crazy) refers to the generous and varied toppings. It is a street food favorite for those with a big appetite, offering an explosion of textures and flavors in one meal.
desc_nasi_goreng_mawut: Nasi goreng mawut, or "messy" fried rice, is a unique dish where fried rice is mixed with fried noodles. The combination of carbs creates a rich, textured experience. Often cooked with shredded chicken, eggs, and plenty of vegetables, it is a flavorful and filling meal that showcases the creative spirit of Indonesian street food, satisfying two cravings in one plate.
desc_nasi_goreng_seafood: This fried rice variation is elevated with a generous amount of fresh seafood like shrimp and squid. The natural juices from the seafood infuse the rice, creating a distinctively savory and oceanic profile. Often garnished with spring onions and served with chili sauce, it is a luxurious yet accessible version of the national dish that highlights the freshness of Indonesia's waters.
desc_nasi_goreng_special: The "Special" fried rice is the ultimate indulgent version, typically featuring a combination of chicken, sausages, meatballs, and eggs. It often includes extra portions and perhaps a richer blend of spices or special sauces compared to standard versions. Served with crackers and pickles, it represents a complete, festive, and highly satisfying meal that is a go-to choice at local eateries.
desc_telur_dadar: Indonesian-style omelet, typically beaten with shallots, chili, and leeks before being fried until crispy and golden. Unlike Western omelets, it is often thinner and cooked with more oil for a crunchier edge. It is a beloved accompaniment to white rice and various side dishes, known for its savory taste and simple preparation, making it a staple in every Indonesian household.
desc_bihun_goreng_bakso: Stir-fried thin rice vermicelli (bihun) seasoned with soy sauce, garlic, and aromatic spices. This version is packed with savory meatball slices (bakso), crunchy vegetables, and scrambled eggs. It is a popular, comforting street food staple that is both light and filling.
desc_bihun_goreng_sosis: A savory stir-fried rice vermicelli dish featuring sliced sausages as the star protein. The noodles are tossed with sweet soy sauce, garlic, and fresh vegetables like cabbage and carrots. It offers a familiar, kid-friendly flavor profile that makes it a perfect quick meal option for lunch or dinner.
desc_bihun_goreng_special: An elevated version of stir-fried rice vermicelli, loaded with a variety of proteins like chicken, shrimp, meatballs, and sausages. It includes a generous mix of fresh vegetables, all stir-fried to perfection with an aromatic blend of seasonings. This hearty dish is designed to be a complete and satisfying meal.
desc_cah_kangkung_polos: A classic Indonesian vegetable dish consisting of water spinach (kangkung) stir-fried quickly over high heat. It is seasoned with garlic, shallots, and sometimes a hint of chili and oyster sauce to enhance its natural flavor. It is a simple, healthy, and crisp side dish that pairs perfectly with steamed white rice.
desc_cah_kangkung_seafood: Fresh water spinach stir-fried with a variety of seafood, typically shrimp and squid. The addition of seafood adds a savory depth to the dish, while the oyster sauce glaze brings everything together. It is a nutritious and flavorful way to enjoy green vegetables with a luxurious touch.
desc_capcay_goreng_special: A vibrant stir-fried vegetable medley, featuring a mix of broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, and baby corn. The special version includes chicken, shrimp, and meatballs, creating a rich texture. Everything is cooked quickly to maintain the crunchiness of the vegetables and the savory, savory-sweet flavor profile.
desc_capcay_kuah_special: Similar to the fried version, but prepared in a rich, thick, savory broth. This comforting soup includes a variety of crisp vegetables, chicken, shrimp, and meatballs. It is a healthy, warming dish often enjoyed during colder weather or as a nutritious dinner, offering a balance of flavors and textures in every spoonful.
desc_fuyunghai_ayam: A fluffy Indonesian-style omelet filled with shredded chicken, chopped vegetables, and aromatics. It is fried until crispy on the edges and then smothered in a sweet and tangy tomato-based sauce, often garnished with green peas. This dish is a fusion classic, beloved for its comforting and contrasting textures.
desc_fuyunghai_seafood: This indulgent version of the Indonesian-style omelet features a blend of shrimp and crab meat. The crispy egg base complements the sweet and tangy tomato sauce perfectly. It is a popular item in many Chinese-Indonesian restaurants, known for being both savory and delightful to eat.
desc_kwetiau_nyemek_ayam: Flat rice noodles (kwetiau) cooked in a small amount of savory, slightly thick broth the nyemek style. It is stir-fried with chicken, eggs, and vegetables, creating a rich and moist texture. The flavor is a blend of sweet soy sauce and spices, providing a satisfying, gooey, and flavorful eating experience.
desc_mie_goreng_special: Classic Indonesian yellow noodles stir-fried with a signature blend of sweet soy sauce, garlic, and spices. The special version is packed with chicken, shrimp, meatballs, and a mix of vegetables. Topped with a fried egg and pickles, this dish is an iconic national treasure enjoyed by all.
desc_mie_nyemek_ayam: A unique noodle dish where the yellow noodles are cooked until they absorb the savory sauce, leaving just enough to be moist or nyemek. Prepared with succulent chicken, eggs, and greens, it bridges the gap between stir-fried noodles and noodle soup, offering a deeply flavorful and comforting bowl.
desc_mie_nyemek_special: The ultimate nyemek noodle experience, featuring a combination of chicken, shrimp, and meatballs cooked in a luscious, semi-thick sauce. The noodles are coated in a savory-sweet glaze, accented by fresh vegetables and aromatics. It is the perfect choice for those who love moist, flavorful noodles.
desc_nasi_goreng_bakso: A popular staple, this fried rice is stir-fried with savory meatballs, egg, and a touch of sweet soy sauce. It is seasoned with shallots and garlic, creating a simple yet incredibly tasty meal. Often served with crackers and fresh slices of cucumber and tomato, it is a quick and satisfying favorite.
desc_nasi_goreng_kambing: A flavorful, aromatic fried rice cooked with tender pieces of goat meat (kambing) and rich spices like cumin and turmeric. This dish is known for its bold, savory taste and is often served with pickles and melinjo nut crackers. It is a hearty and distinctively Indonesian culinary experience.
desc_nasi_goreng_pete: Fried rice infused with the distinctive, bold taste of pete (stink beans). The beans add a unique texture and savory flavor that fans of Indonesian food adore. Stir-fried with chicken or anchovies, eggs, and chili, this dish is a flavorful and adventurous choice for those who love traditional ingredients.
desc_nasi_goreng_sosis: A kid-friendly and universally loved version of Indonesian fried rice featuring sliced sausages. The combination of savory soy sauce, aromatic garlic, and the salty taste of fried sausages makes it an appealing meal at any time of the day. It is simple, consistent, and always hits the spot.
desc_nasi_goreng_teri_medan: A fragrant fried rice mixed with crispy, salty Medan-style anchovies (teri). The contrast between the soft rice and the crunchy, savory fish creates a delightful texture. Often cooked with chili for a hint of heat, it is a delicious, protein-packed dish that brings the taste of the sea to your plate.
desc_nasi_pecel_lele_goreng: This iconic Indonesian dish features deep-fried catfish, renowned for its crispy skin and tender, savory white meat. Served alongside warm steamed rice, a portion of fresh raw vegetables called 'lalapan'—typically cucumber, cabbage, and basil—and a generous dollop of fiery, authentic tomato-based sambal. It is a quintessential, affordable, and incredibly satisfying street food experience.
desc_nasi_pecel_lele_bakar: A smoky and delicious twist on the classic, this dish features catfish marinated in a rich blend of spices and sweet soy sauce before being grilled over charcoal. The result is a caramelized, aromatic fish served with warm steamed rice, fresh raw vegetables, and a spicy chili sambal. The grilling process imparts a deep, savory flavor that perfectly balances the heat of the accompanying sambal.
desc_nasi_pecel_lele_double: For those with a hearty appetite, this 'double' version provides a generous portion of two perfectly deep-fried catfish. Served with steamed rice, a larger helping of fresh lalapan vegetables, and an extra serving of spicy sambal to ensure a flavorful bite in every mouthful. This dish is designed to be highly filling and is a popular choice for lunch or dinner among those seeking a substantial protein fix.
desc_nasi_ayam_goreng: A staple comfort food in Indonesia, this dish consists of chicken seasoned with traditional aromatics like garlic, turmeric, and coriander, then deep-fried to a golden, crispy perfection. Served with warm rice, fresh cooling vegetables, and a vibrant sambal, the chicken remains juicy inside. It is a simple, universally loved meal that offers a wonderful contrast of crunchy skin and tender meat.
desc_nasi_ayam_bakar: This dish features succulent chicken pieces marinated in a savory blend of spices and sweet soy sauce, then grilled until charred and aromatic. Served with steaming rice, fresh vegetables, and spicy sambal, the chicken absorbs the deep, sweet, and savory marinade. It is a healthier, flavorful alternative to fried options, offering a delightful balance of smoky notes and tender chicken texture.
desc_nasi_bebek_goreng: Savor the rich, succulent taste of deep-fried duck, seasoned perfectly with aromatic Indonesian spices. The meat is tender and flavorful, complemented by crispy skin. Served with warm rice, crisp fresh vegetables, and a spicy sambal, this meal offers an elevated, satisfying experience compared to standard chicken, perfect for those seeking a bold and savory traditional Indonesian culinary adventure.
desc_nasi_bebek_bakar: Indulge in the aromatic pleasure of grilled duck, marinated in a complex spice paste and sweet soy sauce. The grilling process enhances the natural richness of the duck, creating a deeply savory profile. Served with hot rice, lalapan, and sambal, it is a sophisticated meal. The combination of smoky, tender, and spiced meat makes this dish a true favorite among Indonesian food enthusiasts.
desc_nasi_ikan_nila_goreng: Enjoy crispy deep-fried tilapia, a popular freshwater fish known for its mild and delicate flavor. Fried to perfection, the skin becomes pleasantly crunchy while the inside stays moist and tender. Paired with warm rice, fresh vegetables, and a fiery sambal, it is a healthy and protein-rich meal. A simple, fresh, and truly satisfying dish that is perfect for any lunch or dinner occasion.
desc_nasi_ikan_nila_bakar: Fresh tilapia grilled until cooked, brushed with a spicy-sweet soy-based glaze, providing a perfectly balanced flavor. The grilling process imparts a delightful smoky aroma, while the glaze permeates the tender fish meat. This grilled tilapia is a healthy yet still delicious choice, perfect when enjoyed with warm rice, fresh vegetables, and green chili sambal that adds to the freshness of the meal for an enjoyable experience.
desc_nasi_ikan_bawal_goreng: Pomfret fish, known for its buttery and soft white meat, is expertly deep-fried until crispy. The result is a delicious contrast between the crunchy exterior and the tender, flaky meat inside. Accompanied by rice, fresh lalapan, and a spicy sambal, it is a culinary treat. Ideal for those who prefer fish with a delicate texture and a rich, satisfying, and classic savory flavor profile.
desc_nasi_ikan_gurame_goreng: The giant gourami is a premium freshwater fish highly prized in Indonesia for its thick, succulent, and meaty texture. Deep-fried until the skin is perfectly crispy and golden, it is served with steaming rice, fresh lalapan, and spicy sambal. It is a centerpiece dish, often enjoyed during family gatherings or special meals, offering an exceptionally delicious and hearty dining experience.
desc_nasi_udang_goreng_tepung: Shrimp are coated in a flavorful, crispy batter and deep-fried to create a light and satisfying crunch. The natural sweetness of the fresh shrimp pairs perfectly with the savory, crispy exterior. Served with warm rice, fresh lalapan, and sambal, it is a favorite for seafood lovers. The dish is simple, fun to eat, and offers a delightful texture that makes it a highly addictive and popular choice.
desc_nasi_cumi_goreng_tepung: Tender rings of squid are dipped in a seasoned batter and deep-fried until golden and crunchy. This dish provides a fantastic balance of chewy, fresh squid and a crispy, savory crust. Served with rice, lalapan, and a spicy sambal, it is an essential seafood dish. It is widely loved for its appealing texture, making it a perfect quick, delicious, and savory option for any seafood enthusiast.
desc_nasi_ati_ampela_goreng: Chicken liver and gizzard are marinated in aromatic spices and then fried until they reach a savory, firm texture. This traditional dish is a common favorite in Indonesian street food stalls, known for its distinct earthy flavor. Served with warm rice, lalapan, and a spicy sambal, it is a simple yet deeply satisfying protein-packed meal for those who enjoy authentic and traditional offal preparations.
desc_nasi_ikan_bawal_bakar: Fresh pomfret fish is marinated in a blend of savory spices and sweet soy sauce before being grilled over hot coals. This process gives the delicate fish a beautiful charred aroma and a rich, sweet, and savory flavor. Served with steamed rice, fresh lalapan, and sambal, it is a healthy, elegant, and flavorful way to enjoy fresh fish, highlighting its natural taste and the savory marinade blend.
desc_nasi_usus_ayam_crispy: Chicken intestines are cleaned and seasoned, then fried until they achieve an incredibly crunchy, snack-like texture. This unique and savory dish is popular as a side or main course, offering a satisfying 'crunch' in every bite. Served with warm rice, fresh lalapan, and a spicy sambal, it is a fun, delicious, and highly addictive Indonesian specialty that is perfect for those seeking unique textures.
desc_nasi_telur_penyet: A simple yet delicious dish featuring a fried egg that is 'smashed' with a spicy sambal directly on the plate. The heat from the sambal infuses the egg, creating a flavorful and satisfying meal. Served with warm rice, fresh lalapan, and often a piece of tofu or tempeh, it is a budget-friendly, comforting, and quintessentially Indonesian dish that proves how simple ingredients can be truly amazing.
desc_nasi_kulit_ayam_krispi: Indulge in crispy chicken skin, deep-fried until perfectly golden and seasoned with aromatic spices. The texture is incredibly satisfying and crunchy, making it a favorite for many. Served with steaming rice, fresh lalapan, and a spicy sambal, it is a savory, flavor-packed dish. It is a popular and addictive treat that highlights the simple pleasure of well-prepared, crispy fried chicken skin.
desc_nasi_tahu_tempe_penyet: A vegetarian-friendly classic, this dish features fried tofu and tempeh that are smashed with a fiery sambal. The result is a flavorful, protein-rich meal with a spicy kick. Served with warm rice and fresh lalapan, it is a healthy, affordable, and incredibly satisfying option. The simplicity of the ingredients combined with the bold, spicy sambal makes this a staple comfort food in Indonesian dining.
desc_nasi_ikan_gurame_bakar: Giant gourami fish is marinated in a sweet, savory, and spicy spice rub before being grilled to perfection. The grilling imparts a lovely, smoky flavor that complements the naturally sweet and firm meat of the gourami. Served with rice, lalapan, and sambal, this dish is a crowd-pleaser, perfect for festive family meals where a large, flavorful, and impressive fish dish is desired for everyone to share.
desc_nasi_burung_puyuh_goreng: Small but flavorful quail is seasoned and deep-fried until the skin is crispy and the meat is tender and juicy. This dish is a unique and delicious delicacy in Indonesia, offering a rich, gamey flavor profile. Served with warm rice, fresh lalapan, and spicy sambal, it is a sophisticated and satisfying meal for those looking to try something different from the standard fried chicken options available.
desc_nasi_burung_puyuh_bakar: Quail is marinated in a complex spice paste and grilled, resulting in an aromatic, tender, and intensely flavorful meal. The grilling process concentrates the spices and adds a smoky depth to the unique taste of the quail meat. Served with steaming rice, lalapan, and sambal, this dish is a refined, savory, and delicious alternative for those who enjoy the gamey and rich qualities of quail meat dishes.
desc_nasi_lele_penyet: This classic dish features crispy deep-fried catfish that is smashed and topped with a fiery, fresh sambal. The heat of the sambal cuts through the richness of the fried fish, creating a perfect balance. Served with warm rice, fresh lalapan, and pieces of fried tofu and tempeh, it is a complete, satisfying, and iconic Indonesian meal that delivers a powerful punch of flavor in every single bite.
desc_nasi_ayam_penyet: Perhaps the most iconic Indonesian dish, this meal features crispy fried chicken smashed with a generous portion of spicy sambal. The contrast between the crunchy skin, tender meat, and the bold, spicy sambal is legendary. Served with rice, lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is the ultimate comfort food, loved by millions for its perfect balance of savory, spicy, crunchy, and satisfying flavors.
desc_nasi_bebek_penyet: Indulge in the rich and savory flavor of deep-fried duck, smashed and paired with an intense, spicy sambal. The duck's distinct, fatty richness is perfectly balanced by the sharp heat of the sambal, creating a bold dining experience. Served with rice, lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is a satisfying, high-protein meal favored by those who enjoy the deeper, more intense flavors of traditional duck.
desc_nasi_udang_bakar: Fresh shrimp are marinated in a sweet and spicy sauce, then grilled to perfection, enhancing their natural sweetness with a smoky aroma. This dish is light yet satisfying, offering a complex and savory flavor profile. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and sambal, it is an elegant and delicious seafood choice, perfect for those who appreciate the delicate and sweet taste of grilled fresh seafood delights.
desc_nasi_cumi_bakar: Tender squid rings are marinated in a fragrant spice paste and grilled, creating a flavorful and smoky seafood delicacy. The grilling process adds depth to the naturally tender squid meat. Served with steaming rice, lalapan, and spicy sambal, it is a savory and delicious meal. A must-try for seafood lovers, this dish offers a unique texture and a balanced, smoky, and spicy flavor profile that is truly enjoyable.
desc_nasi_paru_goreng: Beef lungs are boiled with aromatic spices, then sliced and deep-fried to achieve a crispy, savory, and uniquely chewy texture. This traditional delicacy is prized for its intense flavor and distinct mouthfeel. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and sambal, it is a popular and satisfying dish. It is a flavorful, protein-rich option for those who enjoy the adventurous side of traditional Indonesian cuisine.
desc_nasi_babat_goreng: Beef tripe that has been slow-cooked in traditional spices until tender, then fried until golden brown and crispy. This fried tripe has a chewy texture yet is very savory thanks to the spice marinade that permeates the meat fibers. After frying, the outside is crispy while the inside remains chewy and well-seasoned, making it a delicious side dish when enjoyed with warm rice and the signature sambal from our restaurant.
desc_nasi_burung_puyuh_penyet: Crispy deep-fried quail is smashed with a fiery, fresh sambal, creating a spicy and flavorful experience. The unique, gamey taste of the quail is intensified by the spicy sambal, resulting in a bold and memorable meal. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is a savory, satisfying, and adventurous dish that is perfect for those who want to explore unique Indonesian culinary specialties.
desc_nasi_terong_penyet: Fried eggplant is smashed with a fiery, spicy sambal, resulting in a creamy, savory, and spicy vegetarian delight. The eggplant absorbs the flavors of the sambal, creating a melt-in-the-mouth sensation that is incredibly satisfying. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is a healthy, flavorful, and delicious option that proves how satisfying vegetarian dishes can be in Indonesian cuisine.
desc_nasi_udang_asam_manis: Shrimp are stir-fried in a tangy, sweet, and savory sauce, resulting in a vibrant and delicious seafood dish. The blend of sweet and tangy flavors highlights the natural sweetness of the shrimp, creating a refreshing and balanced meal. Served with steaming rice, this is a popular Chinese-Indonesian influenced dish that is cherished for its bright flavors, tender shrimp, and appetizing, comforting nature.
desc_nasi_cumi_asam_manis: Tender squid is stir-fried in a rich, sweet, and tangy sauce, offering a delightful and flavorful seafood experience. The sauce perfectly complements the mild, tender squid, creating a dish that is both savory and refreshing. Served with steaming rice, it is a popular and comforting meal that combines great textures with balanced, bold, and appetizing flavors, making it a favorite for seafood lovers everywhere.
desc_nasi_babat_penyet: Crispy fried beef tripe is smashed and paired with an intense, spicy sambal, creating a bold, savory, and deeply satisfying traditional meal. The unique, chewy texture of the tripe contrasts beautifully with the fiery sambal. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is a must-try for those who love intense flavors and are looking for a hearty, adventurous, and authentic Indonesian dish.
desc_nasi_paru_penyet: Crispy fried beef lungs are smashed with a fiery, fresh sambal, providing a spicy, savory, and satisfying meal. The chewy, unique texture of the fried lungs is perfectly complemented by the sharp, spicy sambal. Served with rice, fresh lalapan, and fried tofu/tempeh, it is a hearty and flavorful traditional dish, perfect for those who appreciate adventurous offal preparations and intense, bold Indonesian flavors.
desc_nasi_bebek_sambal_ijo: Crispy fried duck is served with a unique, vibrant green chili sambal. The green chili offers a fresher, slightly tangier, and spicy kick that perfectly complements the rich, fatty flavor of the duck meat. Served with steaming rice and lalapan, this dish is a delicious and refreshing twist on the classic fried duck, offering a lighter, zestier, and incredibly satisfying dining experience for every food lover.
desc_nasi_ayam_sambal_ijo: Crispy fried chicken is topped with a refreshing and spicy green chili sambal. The green chilies provide a zesty, tangy, and moderately spicy heat that cuts through the savory fried chicken, creating a perfectly balanced meal. Served with warm rice and fresh lalapan, it is a flavorful and popular choice, offering a bright, spicy, and satisfying alternative to the traditional red chili-based sambal dishes.
desc_nasi_lele_sambal_ijo: Crispy fried catfish is served with a zesty, fresh green chili sambal. The spicy, tangy notes of the green chili perfectly complement the savory, tender catfish. Served with rice and fresh lalapan, this is a fresh and exciting variation of the classic pecel lele. It offers a light, spicy, and tangy flavor profile that is truly appetizing, making it a great choice for those who love spicy food.
desc_nasi_ayam_bakar_padang: White rice served with grilled chicken, prepared using selected spices and cooked over charcoal fire. The grilling process infuses a unique and appetizing smoky aroma, while the blend of sweet soy sauce and spices penetrates deep into the meat's fibers. Its tender texture combined with the dominant savory-sweet flavor profile makes this dish a top choice for those who appreciate delicious, well-cooked chicken.
desc_nasi_ayam_cabai_hijau_lado_mudo: Crispy fried chicken smothered in fresh green chili sambal, a signature from the Minang land. The coarsely ground green chilies are combined with sliced green tomatoes, providing a spicy kick that is not overly sharp but remains fresh on the palate. The combination of savory chicken and the rich green chili sambal creates a truly special dining experience, perfect when paired with warm rice and cassava leaves.
desc_nasi_ayam_goreng_bumbu_serundeng: Rice served with fried chicken seasoned with an abundance of traditional Indonesian spices like turmeric, ginger, and galangal. The chicken is braised first so the spices infuse down to the bone, then deep-fried in hot oil until golden brown. The skin is wonderfully crispy, while the meat inside remains juicy and moist, delivering a savory flavor profile that is truly indulgent for every single bite.
desc_nasi_ayam_goreng_laos: Special fried chicken topped with crispy, golden-brown fried grated galangal (laos). The galangal provides a signature fragrant aroma and a unique savory taste that sticks to the chicken during frying. The crunchy texture of the fried galangal blends with the tender chicken meat, creating a special dining sensation. This menu is highly favored because of the strong galangal aroma that stimulates your appetite for lunch perfectly.
desc_nasi_ayam_gulai: Fresh chicken pieces slow-cooked in a thick, golden-yellow coconut milk curry rich in traditional spices. The curry sauce, made from first-pressed coconut milk, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and turmeric, creates a thick, savory, and highly aromatic broth. The tender chicken meat pairs perfectly with the rich curry sauce, creating a luxurious, warm, and satisfying Padang-style dining experience for you.
desc_nasi_ayam_pop: Warm rice served with signature Minang-style pop chicken, cooked using young coconut water and white aromatic spices. The long simmering process allows the flavors to penetrate deep into the meat fibers, resulting in a clean white appearance and an incredibly tender, soft texture. The deliciousness of this chicken is elevated when dipped into the signature spicy and slightly tangy sambal, making it a favorite menu item.
desc_nasi_dendeng_balado_kering_sariakik: Slices of selected beef dried and then fried until crispy, then coated with a spicy and enticing red balado chili sambal. The crispy texture of the jerky harmonizes perfectly with the balado sambal, which provides a bold spicy kick while leaving the natural savory flavor of the beef intact. This menu is highly sought after for its richness in texture and the consistently spicy taste in every single bite enjoyed.
desc_nasi_dendeng_batokok_cabai_hijau: Beef jerky that is pounded thin before being grilled and topped with a fresh green chili sambal. The pounding technique (batokok) makes the meat fibers softer and allows the seasonings to infuse easily, creating a unique texture when chewed. Served with an abundance of green chili sambal, this menu offers a perfect combination of spicy, savory flavors and satisfying meat texture for lovers of spicy food.
desc_nasi_dendeng_lambok: Beef jerky cooked until moist and tender (lambok) with green chili sambal that permeates the soft slices of meat. Unlike the dry balado jerky, lambok jerky highlights the juiciness and tenderness of the beef with a fresh, spicy green sensation. This menu is highly favored by customers who prefer a tender meat texture and a spicy flavor that isn't too dry, making it a delicious and appetizing choice for your lunch meal.
desc_nasi_gajebo: Cuts of beef brisket with a thick layer of fat, cooked in a fresh and slightly spicy asam padeh broth. The fat on the gajebo provides a chewy texture and an extraordinary savory flavor when bitten. The non-coconut milk asam padeh broth helps to balance the rich fatty flavor, creating a very unique combination of tastes favored by lovers of Padang cuisine who are looking for a distinct, high-quality dish.
desc_nasi_gulai_babat_iso: A combination of tender beef tripe cooked in a thick yellow coconut milk curry with a very strong spice profile. The meticulous cleaning process of the tripe ensures both the hygiene and the deliciousness of this dish. The coconut milk curry, rich in turmeric, lemongrass, and galangal, makes the tripe taste extremely savory and aromatic. The chewy yet easy-to-chew texture makes it a delightful and authentic addition.
desc_nasi_gulai_cumi_isi_tahu_telur: Fresh squid cooked in a thick coconut milk curry sauce, colored dark by the squid ink that blends with the curry spices. The savory flavor of the coconut milk pairs with the natural, slightly sweet, and chewy taste of the squid, creating a unique and rich flavor experience. This dish is a testament to the richness of Minang culinary arts, which fearlessly uses seafood with aromatic spices for an authentic taste.
desc_nasi_gulai_daun_singkong: Fresh cassava leaves cooked until tender in a thick, savory, and spiced coconut milk curry sauce. This vegetable dish is a mandatory complement for any Padang meal, providing a perfectly balanced flavor among other side dishes. The tender texture of the cassava leaves with the rich, spiced coconut milk broth makes every bite of your rice feel more complete, delicious, and highly nutritious, widely loved by our loyal customers.
desc_nasi_gulai_hati_sapi: High-quality beef liver cooked in a thick coconut milk curry sauce rich in selected spices. The beef liver is cooked until tender but maintains a texture that is dense yet soft when bitten. The savory curry sauce permeates the liver, providing a deep and rich flavor profile. This is the right menu choice for those who enjoy offal dishes with strong spice notes and a satisfying, delicious texture that you will definitely enjoy.
desc_nasi_gulai_kapau: A variety of mixed vegetables typical of Kapau, such as young jackfruit, long beans, and cabbage, cooked in a rich and authentic Kapau-style coconut milk curry sauce. Kapau curry sauce tends to be thicker and richer in spices compared to regular curry, providing an extraordinary savory flavor. This dish is a very delicious complement to rice, bringing an authentic traditional taste that will satisfy your palate every time it is served.
desc_nasi_gulai_kepala_ikan_kakap: A large, fresh snapper head cooked in a thick coconut milk curry sauce with a very strong and aromatic spice blend. The curry broth features a balanced sour, spicy, and savory taste thanks to the use of dried sour fruit and various signature spices. The meat around the snapper head is known to be very tender and delicious, providing a highly satisfying dining experience for lovers of seafood and traditional spices.
desc_nasi_gulai_kikil: Chewy beef tendon slow-cooked for a long time in a thick, golden-yellow coconut milk curry sauce that is exceptionally savory. Spices like turmeric, turmeric leaves, and lemongrass provide a highly fragrant and appetizing aroma. The perfectly cooked tendon becomes tender when chewed, absorbing the flavor of the thick curry sauce, creating a deeply satisfying dining experience for lovers of authentic and traditional Padang dishes.
desc_nasi_gulai_otak_sapi: High-quality beef brain carefully prepared and cooked in a signature yellow Padang-style coconut milk curry. The beef brain's incredibly soft, almost cream-like texture pairs perfectly with the spice-laden curry sauce, creating a sensation that is highly savory and rich. This is a dish for those seeking an extraordinary texture and a deeply delicious flavor profile in every single bite you take.
desc_nasi_gulai_pakis: Fresh fiddlehead ferns cooked in coconut milk and selected spices, offering a unique, delicious, healthy, and highly appetizing texture. Ferns have a texture that is slightly crunchy yet soft after being correctly cooked in coconut milk. This dish becomes a refreshing vegetable alternative among the various other coconut-milk-based side dishes, and it is very popular among customers looking for a lighter, delicious vegetable flavor profile.
desc_nasi_gulai_tambusu_usus_isi_telur: A special dish consisting of beef intestine stuffed with a mixture of beaten egg and spiced tofu, then boiled and cooked in a thick coconut milk curry sauce. The combination of chewy intestine with the soft filling creates a unique texture in every bite. The savory curry sauce enriches the flavor profile of this dish, making it a very appealing menu option that is rarely found in other places.
desc_nasi_gulai_tunjang_kikil_sapi: Tunjang curry made from selected beef tendon, slow-cooked in a thick, deep-yellow coconut milk curry sauce rich in traditional spices. Properly cooked tendon results in a texture that is very chewy, soft, and odorless, making it a highly favorite dish. The savory curry sauce permeates the tendon, providing a luxurious taste sensation that is perfect for enjoying with a plate of steaming white rice.
desc_nasi_ikan_bilih: Small bilih fish native to Lake Singkarak, deep-fried until crispy, providing a natural savory taste and a unique crunchy texture in every single bite. This fish can only be found in Lake Singkarak, making it a very special and rare dish. After being fried with simple seasoning, this fish becomes an addictive snack or side dish, providing a crunchy and savory dining sensation that is perfect when paired with red chili sambal.
desc_nasi_ikan_kembung_bakar_padang: Fresh mackerel grilled with selected spices until perfectly cooked, releasing a delightful smoky aroma. The seasoning used provides a savory flavor that permeates deep into the tender fish meat. The grilling process is carefully managed to keep the fish meat juicy and not dry, making it a healthy, tasty, and perfect side dish to be enjoyed alongside warm rice and either green or red chili sambal for a meal.
desc_nasi_ikan_mas_arsik: Carp cooked with a signature yellow spice blend rich in andaliman, creating a spicy, fresh, and uniquely aromatic flavor. The arsik seasoning, which permeates the fish meat, provides a very strong and signature taste. This dish is a favorite menu item that offers a different sensation from other Padang dishes, thanks to the use of authentic spices that provide a slightly numbing effect on the tongue, making it truly delicious.
desc_nasi_ikan_teri_kacang: Crispy fried anchovies combined with savory fried peanuts, glazed in a sautéed seasoning that is sweet and slightly spicy. The crispy texture of the anchovies and peanuts blends with the perfectly caramelized seasoning, providing an incredibly appetizing flavor. This menu is perfect as an additional side dish that provides a contrasting texture and a savory taste to every bite of your rice, widely enjoyed by everyone.
desc_nasi_ikan_tongkol_asam_padeh: Fresh tuna cooked with the signature Padang-style asam padeh seasoning, which is spicy, sour, and fresh. This dish does not use coconut milk, allowing the authentic flavors of sharp spices like red chilies, dried sour fruit, and turmeric to shine through. The clear, reddish broth provides a fresh sensation that stimulates the appetite, making it perfect for those who want to avoid coconut milk while still enjoying a great meal.
desc_nasi_limpa_goreng: Beef spleen prepared with traditional spices until fully infused, then deep-fried until perfectly cooked. The spleen has an incredibly tender and soft texture, almost resembling liver but with a savorier flavor profile. After frying, the outside becomes slightly crispy while the inside remains tender, providing a pleasant texture when enjoyed alongside warm rice and our savory, rich coconut milk curry sauce.
desc_nasi_paru_goreng_crispy: Beef lung thinly sliced and seasoned with spices before being deep-fried to achieve the maximum level of crispiness. This fried lung provides a long-lasting crunchy texture and a deep, savory flavor, making it incredibly delicious when eaten with warm rice. The crunchy texture combined with traditional spice seasoning makes this menu item one of the most sought-after side dishes by our loyal customers.
desc_nasi_perkedel_kentang: Fluffy rice served with a special potato fritter. Selected potatoes are mashed smooth and mixed with sliced celery and fried shallots, then shaped and fried in beaten egg until golden. The texture is incredibly soft on the inside while remaining crispy on the outside, delivering a natural savory potato flavor that pairs perfectly with the subtle, authentic aromatic spices used in the preparation.
desc_nasi_rendang_daging_sapi: The legendary beef rendang, slow-cooked with thick coconut milk and spices for hours until the meat reaches a deep, dark color and the sauce has completely dried. This slow cooking process results in beef that is incredibly tender, almost melting in your mouth, with a savory, deep, and complex spice profile. It is a mandatory menu item that represents the authentic deliciousness of world-famous Minang cuisine.
desc_nasi_sambal_ati_ampela: Selected chicken liver and gizzard cooked with a spicy sambal goreng seasoning rich in red chilies and spices. The dense texture of the liver and gizzard pairs with the spicy, savory, and slightly sweet flavor of the sambal, making it an ideal side dish. This menu is widely favored because the deliciousness of the seasoning penetrates into the liver and gizzard, providing an extra bold flavor to your warm rice.
desc_nasi_tahu_tempe_goreng: A lunch side dish consisting of tofu and tempeh fried with coriander and garlic until savory and perfectly crunchy. The soft inside of the tofu and the dense texture of the tempeh provide a different texture, making them a mandatory side dish. Although simple, the precise frying technique with infused seasoning makes this dish always sought after as a perfect complement to the flavors of lunch at our Padang restaurant.
desc_nasi_telur_barendo: A signature Padang-style omelet fried wide with crispy, lace-like edges (barendo), which is iconic and popular. The eggs beaten with a secret spice blend and then fried in a large amount of hot oil result in a crispy texture on the edges and a soft center. It is perfect to eat with warm rice, providing a very strong savory egg flavor, making it a mandatory side dish at our Padang restaurant for every single visitor.
desc_nasi_telur_bulat_balado: Warm white rice served with a fried hard-boiled chicken egg, generously smothered in a rich red balado chili sauce. The sambal is crafted from selected fresh red chilies, coarsely ground with shallots and a pinch of salt. This creates a sharp, spicy, and savory sensation that is truly appetizing, making it the perfect companion for your rice during a busy afternoon meal, offering a classic flavor.
desc_nasi_terong_balado: Fresh purple eggplant fried until very tender, then drizzled with a spicy and enticing red balado chili sambal. The tenderness of the eggplant that absorbs the oil and the sambal seasoning creates a luscious and delicious dining sensation. The combination of the savory flavor of the eggplant and the spiciness of the balado sambal is the perfect pairing for warm white rice, making it a vegetable menu always ordered by customers.
desc_nasi_udang_balado: Medium-sized fresh shrimp sautéed with a spicy and slightly sweet red balado chili sambal. The shrimp is cooked quickly to remain crunchy and sweet, then coated with a sambal rich in chilies and shallots. The combination of the natural sweetness from the juicy shrimp with the spiciness of the balado sambal creates a perfect balance of flavors, highly popular among seafood lovers at our Padang restaurant.
desc_bakso_polos: Crafted for purists craving the essence of beef. These smooth meatballs offer a natural bouncy texture without excess seasoning. Served in a savory clear broth, this dish showcases our premium ingredients. Delightful with fresh chili.
desc_mie_ayam: A masterpiece of simple culinary arts. Premium noodles tossed in secret oil, served with perfectly infused soy chicken. Fresh greens add natural crispness. Our gold standard; authentic, honest, and nostalgic.
desc_mie_kuah_bakso: Focused on the power of an intense beef broth. Yellow noodles paired with choice meatballs in a soothing soup. Taste the authentic broth from marrow bones. Best for restoring energy and warming the heart.
desc_yamien_bakso: Sweet dry noodles with meatballs. Chewy noodles tossed in signature soy, creating addictive flavor. Served with meatballs and separate broth. Sweet noodles and savory meatballs provide dynamic flavors for lunch.
desc_pangsit_goreng_isi: Fried wontons with chicken filling, crispy outside and soft inside. Perfect as a side dish for noodles or meatballs. The savory chicken filling inside crispy skin offers a new dimension of flavor.
desc_bakso_goreng: Crispy meatballs with a crunchy exterior and chewy interior. The locked-in savory flavor makes it a perfect snack or noodle side dish. Extremely appetizing, especially when enjoyed hot and fresh.
desc_mie_ayam_ceker: Chicken noodles with feet cooked until melt-in-the-mouth. Soy seasonings infuse the chicken, creating an addictive sweet-savory profile. The collagen-rich texture makes every bite incredibly rich. A soft, indulgent adventure.
desc_mie_kuah_ceker: A unique blend of beef noodle soup with tender chicken feet. Collagen extraction gives the broth a distinctive character. The sensation of savory soup paired with collagen-rich feet is a favorite for those seeking uniqueness.
desc_yahun_ceker: Fine yahun combined with tender feet. Soft vermicelli matches perfectly with collagen-rich feet. Clear broth adds soothing freshness. A favorite menu due to its soft texture and balanced savory taste.
desc_yamien_ceker: Sweet yamien with tender feet. Chewy noodles coated in soy, paired with melt-in-the-mouth feet. Separate broth provides freshness. The unique blend of sweet noodles and savory feet provides special satisfaction.
desc_bakso_urat: Coarse meatballs with beef tendon fibers in every bite. Very chewy and savory. For those who love firm beef texture, this is a must-try. Quality tendon ensures a strong meat flavor. Delicious with chili and lime.
desc_mie_ayam_pangsit: Chicken noodles topped with savory minced chicken paired with boiled wontons. The melt-in-the-mouth texture complements the chewy noodles. Highly recommended for lovers of refined, clean, and soul-soothing oriental flavors.
desc_mie_kuah_pangsit: Yellow noodles with soft boiled wontons in clear broth. Very comfortable on the throat, an ideal choice for a light yet satisfying meal. A sprinkle of fried shallots adds a signature aroma to boost appetite.
desc_yahun_pangsit: An elegant blend of yahun and boiled wontons. Soft texture matches the delicate wonton skin. Clear broth unites them, creating a light dining experience. Suitable for those who love soft, clean textures.
desc_yamien_pangsit: Sweet yamien paired with boiled wontons. Chewy noodles in soy seasoning served with soft wontons. Warm broth on the side provides savory balance. The perfect textural blend makes this menu very popular.
desc_bakso_mercon: Meatballs filled with spicy chili that bursts. A challenging sensation for extreme food lovers. The chewy meat balances the fiery heat. Perfect for boosting your lunch adrenaline to stay energetic.
desc_mie_ayam_jamur: Chicken noodles with fresh sautéed mushrooms providing a chewy texture and natural savory taste. The blend of soy chicken and mushrooms creates a delicious earthy richness. An elegant choice for foodies.
desc_mie_ayam_ekstra_sayur: A healthy chicken noodle option with extra green mustard. Provides more crunch and fiber. While maintaining our delicious soy chicken, this menu offers natural freshness in every healthy, wholesome bite.
desc_yahun_bakso: An alternative for glass noodle lovers. Yahun absorbs broth perfectly, providing savory flavor in every strand. Completed with smooth meatballs, this menu feels light yet satisfying. A great choice for digestion.
desc_yamien_komplit: Sweet yamien with complete toppings. Noodles in soy seasoning served with meatballs, wontons, and feet. Separate broth adds freshness. The best choice if you want to experience all our delights in one portion.
desc_bakso_keju: Innovative meatballs with melted cheese filling. The savory sensation of melted cheese creates a modern flavor profile. Very popular among the younger generation who love unique culinary twists on classic traditions.
desc_mie_ayam_pedas_manis: Chicken noodles with an explosive sweet-spicy sensation. Soy seasoning combined with special chili creates an addictive flavor. The right choice for those who love strong, spicy, yet sweet and savory chicken noodles.
desc_mie_kuah_telur: Noodle soup with added boiled egg for extra protein. Clear beef broth perfectly unifies the noodles and egg. A simple, nutritious, and comfortable dish to enjoy when you need energy quickly.
desc_yahun_komplit: Luxurious yahun variant with complete toppings. A blend of yahun, meatballs, wontons, and feet in clear broth. The soft texture makes every topping stand out. Maximum satisfaction in a flavor-rich bowl.
desc_yamien_asin_bakso: Savory-salty yamien with meatballs. Chewy noodles seasoned with chicken oil, no sweetness. For those who dislike sweet noodles, this is the top choice. Savory, salty, and delicious. Authentic flavor.
desc_mie_ayam_bakso: Chewy noodles topped with savory soy chicken and fresh greens. The deliciousness is complete with bouncy beef meatballs. Clear broth provides the perfect balance. A must-have for a complete, filling lunch.
desc_mie_kuah_bakso_urat: Noodle soup with tendon meatballs highlighting pure beef flavor. The tendon texture provides a firm bite. Suitable for a nutritious lunch. The texture gives a solid, satisfying, and soothing sensation.
desc_mie_ayam_bakso_urat: Chicken noodles paired with firm tendon meatballs. Delicious soy chicken meets coarse, chewy beef tendon texture. The right choice if you want to enjoy chicken noodles with a more satisfying protein bite.
desc_yahun_spesial: Special yahun variant with a combination of selected toppings. Yahun's delicacy meets our deep signature seasoning. Provides a light, smooth sensation but with depth of flavor that pampers every loyal customer.
desc_yamien_manis_bakso: Sweet yamien with smooth meatballs. Chewy noodles in soy seasoning served with bouncy meatballs and separate broth. Balanced sweet and savory taste. A classic lunch staple. Soft noodles and dense meatballs.
desc_bakso_pangsit: A harmony of smooth beef meatballs and homemade wontons. Dense chicken filling adds luxury to every bite. Served in clear broth with a fried shallot aroma. The right choice for those seeking pure, satisfying flavors.
desc_mie_kuah_komplit: Rich noodle soup with meatballs, feet, and wontons in clear broth. Every spoonful brings different textures unified in warmth. Perfect for enjoying all our menu highlights in one healthy, nourishing bowl.
desc_mie_bakso_spesial_pedas: Noodle soup with meatballs and extra spice. Clear broth with fresh chili slices provides a challenging spicy sensation. Perfect for spicy food lovers. Soft noodles and bouncy meatballs in savory-spicy broth.
desc_yahun_bakso_urat: Fine yahun combined with firm, coarse tendon meatballs. The vermicelli texture provides extraordinary contrast with firm meatballs. Very delicious and satisfying for tendon lovers wanting a vermicelli sensation.
desc_pangsit_kuah_isi: Chicken-filled wontons in warm broth. Softness of boiled wontons blends with savory beef soup. Very soothing, especially for a light meal that stays delicious and satisfying. Perfect with a drop of vinegar.
desc_bakso_pangsit_ceker: A blend of bouncy meatballs and spiced broth. Chicken feet are slow-cooked to tender perfection. Premium chicken wontons add a soft texture. A warm, authentic dish, perfect for comforting your mood.
desc_mie_ayam_komplit: The ultimate choice with luxury in one bowl. A blend of chewy noodles, soy chicken, meatballs, tender feet, and premium wontons. A flavor symphony guaranteeing maximum satisfaction. A total culinary experience.
desc_mie_ayam_spesial: A special version of classic chicken noodles with richer seasoning and select chicken. Noodles remain chewy, chicken flavor is well-infused. A perfect portion to enjoy our quality, offering deep, authentic flavor.
desc_nasi_bakar_pedas_jantung_pisang: A unique creation of banana blossom with spicy traditional spices. Offers a distinct texture and a delicious natural savory taste. A healthy dish perfect for any meal with family.
desc_nasi_kucing_jamur_pedas: Spicy sautéed oyster mushrooms with prominent aromatic spices. The chewy mushroom texture provides an interesting eating sensation. A vegetarian dish that remains delicious and satisfying for everyone.
desc_nasi_kucing_sambal_samin: Rice with savory, oily, and spice-rich samin sambal. The unique flavor of samin provides an unusual depth of taste. Perfect for those wanting to try something different.
desc_nasi_bakar_teri_medan_kemangi: Savory rice with crispy Medan anchovies and fresh basil aroma. Selected spices make this dish feel perfectly balanced and delightful. Perfect for a practical yet memorable lunch.
desc_sego_sambel_kulit_ayam: Crispy fried chicken skin with a bold spicy sambal. The combination of crunchy texture and savory sambal is satisfying. A menu always sought after for its deliciousness.
desc_nasi_bakar_ayam_jamur: A blend of tender chicken and mushrooms sautéed in Indonesian spices. Savory chicken flavors pair perfectly with chewy mushrooms. The grilling process adds an enticing aroma, perfect for lunch or dinner.
desc_nasi_kucing_sambal_teri: Crispy fried anchovies mixed with a savory, appetizing sambal. The mix of crispy anchovies and fluffy rice is just right. A reliable menu for a tasty and practical snack.
desc_nasi_kucing_tongkol_suwir: Shredded tuna with rich and savory spices. The strong fish flavor makes this dish memorable. A practical menu choice rich in fish nutrients.
desc_nasi_bakar_kepala_ayam_kemangi: Selected chicken heads cooked with aromatic basil and traditional spices. Deeply infused spices create a distinct savory flavor. A traditional dish offering a satisfying culinary experience.
desc_nasi_kucing_ayam_suwir_kemang: Small-portioned rice with shredded chicken and fresh basil aroma. Traditional spices make it savory, perfect as a substantial snack. Practical, delicious, and full of Indonesian flavor.
desc_nasi_bakar_rendang_suwir: Shredded beef rendang with authentic spices that permeate perfectly. The combination of savory and slightly sweet notes makes it a favorite. The grilling process adds an appetizing aroma to your meal.
desc_nasi_bakar_tuna_asap: Smoked tuna with a signature smoky aroma combined with selected spices. Savory fish flavors blend with soft, seasoned rice. A premium dish offering a highly satisfying flavor experience.
nasi_kucing_cumi_asin_cabai_hijau: Nasi Kucing Cumi Asin Cabai Hijau
desc_nasi_kucing_cumi_asin_cabai_hijau: Salted squid sautéed with fresh green chilies, offering a mild, savory heat. The chewy squid combined with warm rice is very appetizing. A simple yet flavor-rich home-style dish.
desc_nasi_bakar_jamur_tiram_pedas: Fresh oyster mushrooms with a chewy texture, cooked with a spicy chili stir-fry. Indonesian spices balance the heat with a satisfying savory flavor. A perfect choice for spicy food lovers.
desc_nasi_kucing_dendeng_suwir: Shredded beef dendeng with a delicious, signature sweet and savory blend. The tender meat texture makes every bite satisfying. A special dish offering a luxurious taste in a humble portion.
desc_nasi_kucing_pindang_rawit: Pindang fish stir-fried with fresh, spicy bird's eye chilies. The savory fish mixes with the heat of the chilies for a bold flavor. A practical choice for a relaxed meal at the angkringan.
nasi_kucing_sambal_goreng_ati_ampela: Nasi Kucing Sambal Goreng Ati Ampela
desc_nasi_kucing_sambal_goreng_ati_ampel: Liver and gizzard cooked in a spice-rich sambal goreng. The texture of the meat pairs perfectly with the savory sambal. A classic dish that is always a favorite.
desc_sego_kikil_bumbu_rujak: Chewy beef tendon in a spicy, sweet, and spice-rich rujak seasoning. The unique flavor of the rujak sauce makes the tendon taste special. A delicious dish for tendon lovers looking for a new sensation.
desc_nasi_kucing_oseng_tempe_kacang: Tempe and peanuts stir-fried in a sweet and savory sauce with a hint of spice. The dense tempe and crunchy peanuts create a perfect harmony. A simple dish that is always missed.
desc_nasi_kucing_tahu_bacem: Tofu bacem with a sweet and savory seasoning infused into the tofu. The soft tofu texture offers a comforting taste. A perfect choice for a light and soothing meal.
desc_nasi_kucing_tahu_gejrot: Tofu drizzled with a fresh, spicy, sweet, and sour sauce. The sharp sauce makes the tahu gejrot very refreshing. A favorite menu to awaken the appetite.
desc_nasi_kucing_telur_dadar_suwir: Shredded omelet with a simple yet savory blend of spices. The soft texture of the egg is the perfect match for rice. A safe and universally loved choice for all ages.
desc_nasi_kucing_kerang_ijo_pedas: Spicy sautéed green mussels offering an authentic savory taste of the sea. Selected spices eliminate any fishy scent and highlight the mussel flavor. Suitable for seafood lovers in a practical, small portion.
desc_nasi_kucing_sate_usus_pedas: Spicy chicken intestine skewers with deeply infused spices. The chewy texture of the intestines is perfect with warm rice. An iconic and well-loved angkringan dish.
desc_nasi_bakar_ati_ampela_petai: Grilled rice with tender liver and gizzard, cooked with traditional spices. Fresh petai adds a distinct aroma and deep, savory flavor. Wrapped in banana leaves and grilled to achieve an appetizing smoky scent.
desc_nasi_bakar_udang_rebon_pedas: Grilled rice with savory rebon shrimp, cooked with a sharp spicy seasoning. Strong aromatic spices make every bite feel special. A delicious choice for those who love bold seafood flavors.
desc_nasi_kucing_balado_telur_puyuh: Quail eggs cooked in a spicy and savory red balado chili sauce. The balado seasoning infuses the eggs perfectly, providing a delicious eating experience. A classic choice favored by many angkringan customers.
desc_sego_gudangan_telur_bacem: Fresh vegetables with grated coconut seasoning and sweet, savory bacem eggs. A healthy, traditional, and very filling combination. A healthy home-style menu for the family.
desc_sego_sambel_belut: Fried eel with fresh, spicy sambal that awakens the appetite. The crispy eel texture meets spicy sambal just right. A unique menu that offers a different eating experience.
desc_nasi_bakar_bandeng_presto: Featuring tender, boneless milkfish rich in traditional spices. Savory, soft fish meat blends with warm rice wrapped in banana leaves. An authentic dish offering a truly satisfying culinary experience.
desc_nasi_bakar_tongkol_pedas: Shredded tuna cooked with a spicy and savory chili stir-fry. The traditional spices infuse the rice, creating a bold flavor. Suitable for fans of spicy fish dishes with a traditional touch.
desc_nasi_kucing_sambal_udang: Sautéed shrimp in a savory sambal with a sweet, spicy touch. The natural sweetness of the shrimp blends with the sharp sambal. A dish that feels luxurious despite the humble portion.
desc_sego_sambel_cumi_petai: Squid and petai sambal with a strong aroma and savory spicy taste. The combination of petai and squid creates a distinct flavor. A delightful treat for fans of strong-aroma dishes.
desc_sego_sambel_paru_goreng: Crispy fried beef lung with a spicy, savory, spice-rich sambal. The unique texture of the lung pairs with the bold sambal. A bold dish for fans of beef offal preparations.
desc_nasi_kucing_sambal_tongkol_suwir: Shredded tuna with a spicy, savory, and rich sambal. Traditional spices give the tuna a stronger character. A satisfying choice for dinner.
desc_sego_kikil_sapi_pedas: Spicy stir-fried beef tendon with sharp and bold spices. The chewy tendon texture pairs perfectly with a satisfying spiciness. A perfect choice for spicy tendon fans.
desc_nasi_bakar_cumi_hitam: Fresh squid cooked in its own natural ink for a deep, savory flavor. Selected spices make this dish feel richer. Perfect for lovers of authentic seafood cuisine.
desc_nasi_kucing_oseng_mercon: Spicy sautéed beef trimmings with bird's eye chilies that explode with heat. The savory beef broth balances the dominant spice. A must-try for those who enjoy the challenge of intense heat.
